title: A question I hope I’m allowed to ask here:
content: How many of you smoke weed? Have you ever? Do you find it affects your ability to lucid dream, or recall them? Or the frequency with which you dream? I’ve been a heavy smoker for 14 years but I’ve been wanting to quit for a while now. One thing I’ve found on my tolerance breaks is that my dreams come in very vividly, without fail every night, they’re very overwhelming. Not always mall world dreams, sometimes just random nightmares. I wonder if with sobriety and practice, I could get more control over the dreams opposed to just watching them happen.
